Introduction.paragraph: Arxia is a Digital Public Infrastructure and Digital Transformation company. Our team of expert consultants and engineers have developed digital projects all over the world, in partnership with international organizations and donors. Our goal is to transform the lives of people through impactful technology and capacity building.
